pages.lesson:
LESSON: KUANDIKA 11.3.1 INSHA ZA KUBUNI MAELEZO

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.3: Kuandika 11.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Maelezo

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 11.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Maelezo. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua vipengele vya mpangilio wa insha ya maelezo
2. kueleza mpangilio wa insha ya maelezo
3. kuandika insha ya maelezo inayozingatia mpangilio ufaao wa maelezo

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua vipengele vya mpangilio wa insha ya maelezo
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua vipengele vya mpangilio wa insha ya maelezo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kueleza mpangilio wa insha ya maelezo
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza mpangilio wa insha ya maelezo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kuandika insha ya maelezo inayozingatia mpangilio ufaao wa maelezo
   In simple words: practise until you can kuandika insha ya maelezo inayozingatia mpangilio ufaao wa maelezo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 11.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Maelezo using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 11.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Maelezo in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 11.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Maelezo to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 11.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Maelezo.
4. Show that you can: kutambua vipengele vya mpangilio wa insha ya maelezo

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 11.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Maelezo using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 11.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Maelezo important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua vipengele vya mpangilio wa insha ya maelezo
2. kueleza mpangilio wa insha ya maelezo
3. kuandika insha ya maelezo inayozingatia mpangilio ufaao wa maelezo

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
